name: Dictionary.RemoveKey
summary: Removes a key and its value from a dictionary.

name: Dictionary.Serialize
summary: Encodes a dictionary as a text value for later deserialization.
differences: Round-trip behavior is covered by the MBS Dictionary tests.

name: Dictionary.SetList
summary: Sets dictionary entries from a delimited text list.

name: Dictionary.SetQuickList
summary: Sets dictionary entries from a QuickList reference.

name: Dictionary.SetTag
summary: Stores a tag value on a dictionary.

name: Dictionary.SetValueForKey
summary: Stores a value under a key in a dictionary.

name: Dictionary.ToJSON
summary: Converts a dictionary to formatted JSON text.

name: Dictionary.ToText
summary: Returns dictionary entries as tab and return separated text.

name: Dictionary.ValueForKey
summary: Returns the value stored for a dictionary key.

name: Dictionary.Values
summary: Returns dictionary values in key order.

name: Dictionary.ValueTypeForKey
summary: Reports the stored type for a dictionary key.

name: Regex.CaptureCount
summary: Returns the number of capture groups for a compiled expression.

name: Regex.Compile
summary: Compiles a pattern and returns a session scoped reference.
differences: The implementation translates supported PCRE syntax to JavaScript regular expressions; unsupported syntax is reported as an MBS error.

name: Regex.Execute
summary: Runs a compiled expression against text and stores its match results.

name: Regex.Extract
summary: Returns text produced by matching a pattern and replacement.

name: Regex.FindMatches
signature: Regex.FindMatches ( regexReference ; text ; options ; offset ; mode )
summary: Finds matches using a compiled expression.

name: Regex.Free
summary: Releases a compiled expression reference.

name: Regex.List
summary: Lists compiled expression references in the current session.

name: Regex.Match
summary: Reports whether a pattern matches text.

name: Regex.MatchList
summary: Returns lines matching a regular expression.

name: Regex.NameCount
summary: Returns the number of named capture groups.

name: Regex.NamedSubstring
summary: Returns the matched substring for a named group.

name: Regex.Options
summary: Returns options associated with a compiled expression.

name: Regex.Pattern
summary: Returns the pattern associated with a compiled expression.

name: Regex.Quote
summary: Escapes text so regular expression metacharacters are literal.

name: Regex.Release
summary: Releases compiled expression references.

name: Regex.ReleaseAll
summary: Releases all compiled expressions in the current session.

name: Regex.Replace
signature: Regex.Replace ( text ; pattern ; replacement ; options ; start ; count )
summary: Replaces a match in text.

name: Regex.ReplaceAll
summary: Replaces all matching portions of text.

name: Regex.Results
summary: Returns the offsets and lengths from the last execution.

name: Regex.StringNumber
summary: Returns the capture number associated with a group name.

name: Regex.Study
summary: Returns the engine response for studying a compiled expression.
differences: This implementation returns a fixed success response; further compatibility is unverified.

name: Regex.Substring
summary: Returns a captured substring from the last execution.

name: Regex.SubstringList
summary: Returns captured substrings as a return separated list.

name: Regex.Version
summary: Returns the regular expression implementation version.
differences: The returned version describes the local implementation and compatibility with the plug-in version is unverified.

name: XML.ApplyStylesheet

differences: Stylesheet support is implemented locally; compatibility beyond existing tests is unverified.

name: XML.ApplyStylesheet2
summary: Applies a stylesheet with parameter pairs.
differences: Stylesheet support is implemented locally; compatibility beyond existing tests is unverified.

name: XML.Canonical
summary: Returns a canonicalized XML representation.

name: XML.Compact
summary: Returns compact XML text.

name: XML.DeletePath

name: XML.ExtractText
summary: Returns text content from XML.

name: XML.Format
summary: Formats XML text for readable display.

name: XML.GetAttribute
summary: Returns a root element attribute value.

name: XML.GetPathValue
summary: Returns the text value selected by an XML path.

name: XML.GetSaveNoEmptyTags
summary: Reports the session setting for empty XML tags.

name: XML.HasAttribute

name: XML.ItemRefs
summary: Returns references for XML items.

name: XML.List
summary: Lists parsed XML references in the current session.

name: XML.ListAttributes
summary: Lists attributes on the root element.

name: XML.NodeCount
summary: Counts XML nodes selected by names.

name: XML.NodeNames
summary: Returns XML node names.

name: XML.Parse
summary: Parses XML and returns a session scoped reference.

name: XML.Query
summary: Selects XML content using a path query.

name: XML.ReleaseAll
summary: Releases parsed XML references in the current session.
